method.description: Pastes a prompt into a running agent once it is ready; resolves when the delivery has settled. The text is sent as one bracketed paste: line breaks become CR, ESC becomes ␛, and the whole is wrapped in ESC[200~ … ESC[201~.

ready.description: the agent already shows its input; paste without waiting for a ready signal

method.description: How deliver would submit a prompt to an agent: whether Enter rides with the paste, the delay before a separate Enter, and the retry delay.

text.description: The prompt the delay is computed for.

enterWithPaste.description: Enter is written in the same write as the paste.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds between the paste and a separate Enter.

retryMs.description: Milliseconds after the first Enter before a second one, or null when there is none.

method.description: Runs an agent (or a custom command) once, non-interactively, and returns what it printed. Catalog model and option picks are checked and applied to the one-shot arguments; the prompt goes to the agent's stdin or argv by its one-shot shape. The run is limited to 60 seconds and 4 MiB of output.

agent.description: An agent ID with a one-shot shape, or custom to run args as the whole command line.

model.description: Catalog model to use; if omitted, the one-shot default applies.

optionValues.description: Catalog option picks such as {effort: "high"}; string or boolean values. An option-only pick uses the one-shot default model. Unsupported picks fail before a process starts. Custom commands do not accept catalog picks.

args.description: CLI arguments merged into the agent's one-shot arguments; a flag the agent takes once replaces Quirky's own. For custom, the command line, where {prompt} stands for the prompt (else it goes to stdin).

cwd.description: The folder to run in; an existing absolute directory. Defaults to the worktree path.

worktree.description: The worktree whose path is the default cwd; defaults to the caller's.

timeoutMs.description: How long the run may take; defaults to 60000.

requestId.description: A caller-chosen ID that cancelGenerate can name while the run is in flight.

text.description: The agent's stdout, ANSI-stripped and decoded per its output format; not trimmed.

args.description: Its arguments, prompt included for argv delivery.

method.description: Stops the generate run with this requestId: its whole process group is killed and the run fails with reason cancelled.

cancelled.description: False when no run with this requestId is in flight.
